decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - Reason for Approval: It is considered that the proposed use is recreational in character and takes place in an existing.building. It therefore complies with the Council's U.D.P. policies ENV-B.1.1 and the other policies relating to the Conservation Area, Metropolitan Open Land and Historic Parks and Gardens. It is considered that the development shoul d y be permitted for a temporary period only to enable the Council to reassess the scheme's traffic and parking implications once the use is established.
Condition : 2 - This permission shall be for a limited period only, expiring 31st July 2007, when the use shall be discontinued.
Condition : 3 - The use shall only be carried out Monday-Friday 10.00 a.m. to 3.30 p.m.
description: Change of use of part of existing cricket club to mother and toddler drop-in club (Mon - Fri between 10am - 3pm) incorporating fenced garden area, tea / coffee and snack facilities
